meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自动判断你给的是文档网站、GitHub 仓库、PDF 还是视频等来源,再把它抓取、转换成 AI 可读的技能;还能按需增强、打包,或导出到向量数据库。
howto.when: 当你要求把文档、代码仓库、PDF、视频等来源做成技能,或想同步更新已有技能、导出到向量数据库时,它会接管。

say.text: 把这个文档网站做成一款技能
say.note: 它会先判断来源类型再抓取

say.text: 用 owner/repo 这个仓库生成技能
把这份 PDF 转成技能并打包

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude detects whether your input is a docs site, GitHub repo, PDF, or video, then scrapes and converts it into an AI-ready skill. It can also enhance, package, or export skills to vector databases on request.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to turn sources like documentation, repos, PDFs, or videos into a skill, sync existing skills, or export them to vector databases.

say_en.text: Turn this documentation site into a skill
say_en.note: It detects the source type first

say_en.text: Build a skill from the owner/repo repo
Convert this PDF into a skill and package it
